citation: Batista da Silva C, Berto LA, Volpato MC, Ramacciato JC, Motta RH, Ranali J, Groppo FC. Anesthetic efficacy of articaine and lidocaine for incisive/mental nerve block. J Endod 2010;36(3):438-41
what_it_shows: Randomised double-blind crossover trial in 40 volunteers: articaine vs lidocaine (both with epinephrine) deposited around the incisive/mental nerve; onset, success and duration of pulpal anaesthesia measured (articaine more successful and longer for most teeth). A perineural articaine injection in people with a measured outcome; no examination of the nerve. Baroni's ref 9.

citation: Silva CB, Groppo FC, Santos CP, Serpe L, Franz-Montan M, de Paula E, Ranali J, Volpato MC. Anaesthetic efficacy of unilamellar and multilamellar liposomal formulations of articaine in inflamed and uninflamed tissue. Br J Oral Maxillofac Surg 2016;54(3):295-300
what_it_shows: Rat experiment: articaine with epinephrine and two liposomal articaine formulations injected near the infraorbital foramen (infraorbital nerve block) in uninflamed tissue, and into a paw incision in inflamed tissue; success and duration of anaesthesia measured. A perineural articaine injection in animals with a measured outcome; no examination of the nerve. Found by a PubMed search run for Baroni, not in its reference list.
